Changelog: Validated source update. Development preview; native acceptance remains separate.

Author: kaldigo

Allow the original context menu time to close. Report unavailable native actions and unexpected quantity dialogs in chat instead of failing silently. Native in-game acceptance remains pending.

Author: NightmareXIV, kawaii
Name: AutoRetainer
Description: Collect and assign ventures to your retainers from the comfort of your bed.
Punchline: Collect and assign ventures to your retainers from the comfort of your bed.
Changelog:
## 4.6.3.23

Add safe standalone operation when Steward is absent, disconnected or unavailable: continue native entrust/retrieval, ventures and gil while pausing all disposal, automated market and glamour work. Gate fresh/unregistered profiles and final native submission paths as well as optional postprocessors. Keep uncertain transaction holds. Manual-items retainers, including Skaenwyda, now use the existing venture path when due, preserving the five-minute wait, gil withdrawal, item exclusions and strategy throttle.

## 4.6.3.22

Preflight unique-item entrust conflicts against live retainer contents. Report and skip an already-owned unique item before submitting a game command, then continue with other items. Preserve ordinary duplicate stacking and the native entrust executor. Apply the same eligibility check to companion overflow.

## 4.6.3.21

Make AutoRetainer the sole storage-routing authority with read-only live plan eligibility for Steward overflow and one-time migration of the currency/nonmarketable role into AutoRetainer settings. Preserve native entrust execution and protection checks. Prepared managed cleanup plans can select explicitly permitted non-equipment categories through Steward; retain native methods and stack limits, and explain stack-limit holds in previews.

Add exact source-slot, aggregate quantity, busy-state and elapsed-time diagnostics for rejected disposal acknowledgements. The 11:06 desynthesis of Goatskin Cesti succeeded according to the player but failed acknowledgement; this diagnostic change does not relax validation or claim to fix that failure.

Fix batch cleanup stopping after GC when desynthesis is locked. Share the quest-aware desynthesis eligibility check between companion routing and the existing vendor queue, so an item cannot be routed to selling and simultaneously reserved for unavailable desynthesis. Preserve item approvals and no-progress stops. Add unlock/method/level routing regressions. Full native rerun remains pending.

Add optional Steward full-cleanup coordination using existing retainer postprocessing, GC delivery, desynthesis, vendor actions and configured bell-return travel. The explicit cycle respects enabled methods and exclusions, enforces GC-first routing, counts confirmed transfers/disposals, and stops on no progress, interruptions, remaining candidates or seal capacity. It never resumes after reload and does not start from enabling Steward. Require a home-world, idle, non-demo start and configured return travel for GC. Managed vendor selection skips gil-only retainers. Native acceptance of the complete batched loop remains pending.

Fix GC reward identity matching for multiword item names. Compare the full displayed and expected names with only outer padding trimmed; the previous code removed internal spaces from the displayed name alone. The 09:31 UTC diagnostic run on 4.6.3.16 confirmed unchanged inventory, allowed permission and a 63 ms approval age, with only dialog matching failing. Add regression checks for Boots of the Divine Hero, missing/incorrect names and substring rejection; log observed reward text on a mismatch. Full in-game delivery acceptance remains pending.

Fix the Steward GC approval guard reading the hidden supply list after the reward modal opens. Keep the captured item approval and recheck its inventory fingerprint, character, current permission, expiry and matching reward (or owned HQ confirmation). AutoRetainer still selects and delivers items. Capture approval only when a selection is submitted, and ignore closed/invisible confirmation addons when selecting the next item. Preserve one-shot delivery and inventory acknowledgement checks. The 2026-10-27 diagnostic run showed item 8240 selected at 09:06:55 UTC and rejected 47 ms later solely because the list reader returned zero rows; no delivery was submitted. Regression checks cover missing/mismatched reward identity, changed inventory/quality/quantity, revoked permission, expiry and HQ dialog ownership. Native acceptance of the corrected flow remains pending.

Add diagnostic logging for Steward-managed GC delivery: record selected items and inventory sources, the individual confirmation-check inputs on rejection, and observed delivery acknowledgements. Keep all existing approval, confirmation and acknowledgement checks. This diagnostic release does not claim to fix the reported GC confirmation stop; in-game evidence is still needed.

Fix severe update stalls after adding the first inherited protection to a Steward cleanup plan. Resolve the current local/global protection union without serializing the prepared equipment candidate lists on every read. Preserve live scalar settings, demo mode, raw plan access and ordinary upstream inheritance. Regression coverage includes adding/removing protections, every settings field, unchanged inputs and bounded allocation with 22,766 candidates. Native performance acceptance remains pending.

Check entrust category/duplicate matches before consulting Steward, retaining policy checks at candidate selection, command submission and numeric confirmation. Before a companion-requested armoire or dresser visit, close the bell through the existing AutoRetainer handler and wait for it to release. Continue using upstream travel and storage workflows. Original identity, navigation, enabled methods and demo mode remain unchanged. In-game speed and collection acceptance remain pending.

Fix the Steward collection sweep stalling at the retainer list: reuse AutoRetainer’s existing decoded retainer list and selector instead of converting a native byte span to text. Log retainer selection steps. Publish the previously tested companion storage/gil-only boundaries, optional strategy coordination, GC-first disposal priority and shared demo-mode guard for GC delivery, desynthesis and selling. Native retainer selection remains unchanged. Original plugin identity and upstream functionality are preserved. In-game collection acceptance remains pending.

Steward decision-review integration: optional collection sweep reuses existing retainer postprocessing; read-only disposal selection shares the original hard-list predicate and enabled methods. Original identity, recoloured icon, workflows and protocol-6 safety gates remain unchanged. Paired Steward update intended for log-only decision validation; native execution acceptance remains pending.

Protocol 6 storage preview: optional companion-owned overflow pass reuses bell/retainer/postprocess workflows and native entrust command. Exact per-item Store bridge, unique/space guards and destination acknowledgements retain pending review on uncertainty. Original identity, icon and existing functionality remain unchanged. Native acceptance pending.

Repeated safety review: protocol 5 and an independent synchronous policy ledger replace the incorrect assumption that EzConfig writes propagate disk failures. Managed NPC/retainer sales, desynthesis and armoire storage journal before submission and require exact acknowledgement; remaining jobs wait. Ordinary config imports cannot remove ownership. Review/detach reject backlogged work. Withdrawal binds retainer/HQ and pause managers retain pending transaction guards. Original identity and workflows remain. Native acceptance and safe cross-zone collection refresh are still pending.

Author: kaldigo
Name: Steward
Description: Collection-aware inventory decisions and market rules coordinated with the AutoRetainer integration fork. Starts in dry-run mode.
Punchline: Collect what matters. Sell the surplus.
Changelog:
## 0.1.0.56

Defer Steward storage travel while AutoDuty owns the run, expire previous follow-up travel permission and leave glamour collection items on retainers for later. Preserve native AutoRetainer GC execution and disposal protections, including the managed-discard prohibition. Add coordination regression checks; live AutoDuty acceptance remains to be tested.

## 0.1.0.55

Dresser cleanup skips unique items already carried in bags, armoury or equipped, warns the player and continues. Recheck live ownership before restoration and wait when inventory is unavailable. Close the dresser after automatic storage work finishes; do not close pending confirmations or active operations.

## 0.1.0.54

Require AutoRetainer standalone capability 5 and explain disconnected behaviour. Permit clean disconnect with saved collection holds retained for reconnection, while keeping uncertain-transaction holds. Skaenwyda remains excluded from storage and ordinary sales, with native ventures and gil enabled in AutoRetainer. Requires AutoRetainer 4.6.3.23.

## 0.1.0.53

Remove the master Enable automation switch: enabled features follow AutoRetainer, with log-only and genuine inventory-review holds retaining their gates. Settings edits replan pending decisions without switching participation off or cancelling acknowledgement of a submitted action. Report and skip verified unsubmitted item failures; preserve uncertain-submission, journal-save and cleanup holds. Clear operation journals for safe cancellation so rejected items cannot block the next login.

## 0.1.0.52

Remove duplicate storage assignments from Steward. Ordinary entrust follows AutoRetainer's selected plan; protected overflow and previews query the current AutoRetainer plan. Migrate the currency storage role once into AutoRetainer. Add opt-in non-equipment disposal categories on the Storage page, preserving sale priority, reserves, exclusions, price-data holds and native disposal controls. Review evidence records the item or category permission. Requires AutoRetainer 4.6.3.21.

## 0.1.0.51

Keep housing items in their assigned storage categories regardless of marketability, using the same Housing grouping as the category selector. Nonmarketable furniture no longer goes to the currency retainer. Preserve all storage exclusions and protection checks. Existing stored items are not moved automatically.

## 0.1.0.50

Route all equipment by its assigned storage category regardless of marketability. Limit the currency retainer to currencies and nonmarketable non-equipment, preserving gearset, item/category, retainer and unlock exclusions. Clarify the storage labels and help text. Existing category assignments apply without editing live AutoRetainer settings; items already stored are not moved automatically.

## 0.1.0.49

Wait 500 ms and retry at most twice after a dresser restoration explicitly returns false (no command submitted). Require unchanged source identity, stored-part bytes and source/destination counts, plus fresh protection and control checks; accepted or uncertain submissions never retry. Log every retained dresser entry and its rule reason so skipped items can be distinguished from unprocessed items after a stop. Native acceptance remains pending.

## 0.1.0.48

Resolve queued dresser restoration sources against current positions after each removal. Verify exact dresser-copy loss and player-copy gain rather than assuming positions remain stable, wait for transient loading, hold already-carried unique items, and report precise preflight/native/acknowledgement failures. Preserve per-action last-copy protection and verify the owned control lease. The reported Eternal Shade stop has insufficient diagnostics to prove its cause; in-game acceptance remains pending.

## 0.1.0.47

- Add explicit Run full cleanup / `/steward cleanup`: AutoRetainer visits included retainers, Steward withdraws approved disposal candidates, and AutoRetainer runs enabled GC, desynthesis and sale actions before returning for another batch. No venture timing requirement, market listing or glamour removal is introduced by this pass.
- Keep GC-first priority and per-item live checks. Count only confirmed withdrawals and disposal acknowledgements. Stop on no progress, outstanding GC candidates, method failures, capacity, lost permission, cancellation, or the bounded batch limit. Unique duplicates wait for a later batch.
- Require the companion cleanup capability and AutoRetainer's return-travel configuration for GC batches. Start is explicit, blocked in log-only/demo mode, and never resumed on plugin load. Retainer exclusions include the manual/gil-only retainer. Stop full cleanup also disables Steward automation.
- Core, integration and build checks cover the new cycle; the full live retainer-to-disposal-to-return loop still needs in-game acceptance.

## 0.1.0.46

- Enabling automation now waits for an actual AutoRetainer retainer handoff. It no longer starts a dresser, armoire, cleanup or overflow run from the idle timer. Explicit Run now actions still work, and authorized collection can finish its withdrawal/storage stages. Run permission is not saved and is cleared when stopped, completed, or automation is re-enabled.
- Check carried glamour gear for required repairs and missing glamour prisms before requesting the dresser route. Report what needs attention and resume the authorized pass when it is ready; self-repaired gear above 100% condition remains eligible.
- Regression coverage includes idle enable/reload, owned handoffs, character changes, stop/re-enable, manual runs, and repair/prism preparation. In-game acceptance remains pending.

## 0.1.0.45

- Fix ordinary dresser binding resolution: Dalamud's single-match scanner follows leading call instructions. Use literal multi-match scanning and require exactly one body and caller match before verifying their agreement.
- Add production-binding regression checks reproducing the scanner behaviour and holding missing, ambiguous or disagreeing signatures.
- The 0.1.0.44 live test confirmed two new-outfit deposits. Ordinary deposits stopped before submission; existing-outfit additions remain unverified in game.

## 0.1.0.44

- Replace ordinary dresser row selection and confirmation clicks with a verified MirageManager member-function binding. Both function and caller signatures must agree; unavailable bindings hold storage.
- Use existing native outfit calls to create outfits and fill missing pieces in matching-quality outfits. Submit one approved inventory source at a time.
- Preserve live protection checks, gearset exclusions, owned AutoRetainer coordination, repair/prism requirements and reserved dresser space. Require source removal plus live collection ownership before acknowledging each deposit; uncertain submissions are never retried automatically.
- Log the ordinary, new-outfit or existing-outfit route and confirmed transfer for the upcoming in-game test. Automated and static verification are complete; live acceptance of these three routes is not yet established.

## 0.1.0.43

- Fix the native crash when selecting a dresser item. The generic list-event helper omitted the tree-item pointer required by the dresser. Submit the exact unsigned callback payload used by the game's ordinary left-click handler instead.
- Preserve native source/category validation, confirmation ownership, final protections and source/destination acknowledgement. Crash-recovery review holds remain in place.
- The preceding live run confirmed 31 withdrawals and prompt return travel; it crashed on the first dresser selection before confirmation. Automated checks cannot establish live native acceptance.

## 0.1.0.42

- Restore retainer collection when eligible gear is already in player inventory or the armoury chest. Existing carried gear no longer prevents missing-copy withdrawals; space, duplicate and protection checks remain.
- Select the dresser source category for each inventory container and wait for native list rebuilding. Match item rows using agent index, source container and slot instead of display names or row order.
- Preserve immediate return after withdrawal passes, including long-running passes. Add retainer/source/player-count evidence to withdrawal logs.
- Automated checks pass; the complete live cycle still needs in-game acceptance. Disposal settings and AutoRetainer's executor are unchanged; outfit-conversion windows remain held.

## 0.1.0.41

- Correct ordinary dresser storage using the recorded manual list-click, owned Yes/No, and inventory/dresser acknowledgement flow. Resolve tree entries independently of agent rows, which exclude headers.
- Bind dresser confirmations and cancellation to the exact selected source and agent context; parentless ordinary confirmations no longer fail ownership checks. Protection and live completion checks remain mandatory.
- Resume collection storage immediately when the AutoRetainer withdrawal pass finishes, clearing the earlier visit's retry timer. Finish carried collection batches before starting another sweep.
- Automated regression checks cover confirmation identity and delayed transfer evidence. Live multi-item acceptance is still required; outfit conversion remains held.

Add an opt-in, read-only manual dresser trace (`/steward trace dresser`, `/steward trace stop`) to capture ordinary-item UI events, exact selection and confirmation ownership without automation. Two-minute / 200-record limit; requires idle/off automation and preserves the execution-review hold. Full-flow audit identifies a stale return-route cooldown and distinguishes ordinary items from the outfit-only reference implementations. This diagnostic build does not fix or enable automatic dresser storage. No protection/settings changes.

Reduce entrust work without relaxing live protection: permission checks refresh current inventory and glamour references, while price/import/prefetch processing stays on its normal background cadence. Plan collection and overflow from one refreshed snapshot, then revalidate each source before submission. Do not queue disposal withdrawals that AutoRetainer has not selected. Request AutoRetainer collection visits when live storage observations are missing instead of waiting for the user to open storage first. Select dresser items without closing the selection window; tolerate the bounded selection-to-confirmation transition while preserving exact source, confirmation ownership and destination acknowledgement checks. Compared GlamourLog's native storage implementation and bulk-only IPC; no bulk bypass or copied AGPL implementation. Both plugin updates are required. In-game acceptance remains pending; AutoRetainer activation lifecycle integration remains the recorded final-release blocker.

Improve dresser failure diagnostics: record the selected item, source slot and actual window ownership/readiness at the rejected step. Correct the misleading cancellation error when the dresser selection window has disappeared but no confirmation remains. Cancellation and submission still require the original confirmation owner. This diagnostic update does not claim to resolve the unverified in-game deposit failure. Navigation and existing automation/protection settings are unchanged.

Fix collection withdrawal planning stopping after selecting a retainer: count waiting dresser items from captured candidates while retaining live protection checks. Apply the fix to both initial planning and pre-transfer capacity checks. Preserve transaction holds and log full exception details for future failures. Existing automation, disposal and protection settings are unchanged. In-game acceptance remains pending. Following AutoRetainer activation for all background collection/storage work remains a final-release requirement, not a capability of this update.

Fix decoded retainer names in storage progress labels and keep the window closed on startup/reload. Publish the previously tested collection/storage exclusions, persistent protection handling, disposal-route logging, turnover-based sale rotation, optional dedicated dye strategy, and confirmed-empty-market Universalis-average fallback. Requires AutoRetainer storage capability 3 for automatic execution. Existing feature settings are preserved; no automation is enabled by this update. In-game collection acceptance remains pending.

Replace category checkboxes with clickable icon buttons: blue highlights for selected categories and amber borders for partial saved selections. Use combined category names and counts in selected summaries. Hide Soul Crystals from the picker and exclude them from Select all. Preserve existing rule scope, four marketboard-style groups, whole-group controls and wrapped icon rows. No automation or protection policy changes.
